summary.text: Michael Kelly has represented the 15th District in the Illinois House of Representatives since November 2021.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature biography, he was born June 23, 1975, graduated from Saint Patrick High School in Chicago, and earned a degree in business management from Quincy University.
The biography says he is a Chicago Fire Department firefighter and a member of Local 2, and that he became athletic director at Saint Edward Elementary School in 2006.
